en.headline: Wong Tai Sin Temple keeps Mid-Autumn lanterns lit into October
en.dek: Sik Sik Yuen's free display at the temple and square runs from 17 September to 4 October, with later closing times through the festival week.
body: Sik Sik Yuen said its Mid-Autumn lantern evening at Wong Tai Sin Temple continues nightly through 4 October, marking both the festival and the organisation's 105th anniversary.

According to the organiser, lanterns made with traditional bamboo-and-silk craft are installed inside the temple grounds and on the temple square. The display includes classic Mid-Autumn figures, lanterns associated with the temple, and a piece depicting a Hong Kong astronaut.

The temple is extending evening hours during the event: until 9pm on weekdays, 10pm on weekends and public holidays, and 11pm on 25 September, the Mid-Autumn Festival night. Admission is free. Sik Sik Yuen said last entry is one hour before closing and that crowd-control measures may be used.

The organiser also listed riddle games and stargazing sessions among the programmes on selected nights. The lantern run overlaps the final days of the Victoria Park Mid-Autumn carnival, which ends on 27 September.

zh.headline: 黃大仙祠中秋綵燈展出至十月初
zh.dek: 嗇色園在祠內及廟宇廣場免費展出花燈，活動由9月17日舉行至10月4日，中秋期間延長開放。
body: 嗇色園表示，黃大仙祠「普濟香江」中秋綵燈晚會繼續舉行至10月4日，同時紀念園方成立105周年。
園方指，祠內及廟宇廣場展出以傳統紮作技藝製作的花燈，包括經典中秋造型、黃大仙祠專屬花燈，以及香港太空人升空造型花燈。
活動期間祠宇延長開放：星期一至五至晚上9時，星期六、日及公眾假期至晚上10時，中秋正日9月25日至晚上11時。免費入場。園方表示最後入場時間為關園前一小時，現場或會實施人流管制。
園方亦列出部分晚上有猜燈謎及天文觀星等節目。維園中秋綵燈嘉年華則展出至9月27日。
